- Current Suicide Risk Level: Immediate (current active suicidal thoughts with plan, access to method, and intent to act with short [e.g., < 24 hour] timeframe, may have engaged in preparatory behaviors)
- Current Suicidal Thoughts and Behaviors: Active suicidal thoughts with plan and intent
- Disclosure of Suicide Risk: Low (no explicit mention of suicidal thoughts or self-harm; distress may be present; references to death or disappearance are vague or indirect)

- Treatment Engagement / Access: Active (currently engaged in therapy/meds; regular participation)

- Reaction to provider Responses: Disengaged (minimal uptake; non-committal or withdrawing)

# Seed phrase — character insight only:
